<!-- pr-reviewer: 1bb313d880cbcaf384ec4905462a4a7939358663 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- Unpicked `stock_source` maps to #401's rule (`setup_stock::implicit`); nothing is written to a file or an op stamp until a pick is made (`operation/stamp.rs` adds the term only when `stored()` is `Some`). Existing goldens and the setup_carry suite are unchanged.
- `SetSetupStockSource` is validated at construction (first setup, refused carry named, no-op), and `invert` restores the stored value including "never picked". Because the pick rides the setup's stamp, its ops go Stale and undo returns them.
- `Own` plus a different hold is a new block, and `fold_left` carries the gouges of the block left behind into the verdict, so a gouge there still blocks the post.
- Project v57 is additive: the key is absent when unpicked, an unknown word is refused by name, and the version bump is correctly non-breaking.
- No unwrap/expect/panic in the new code. Provenance lines are present. Layering holds: the UI only queues a `CommandKind`. Plain labels. The `.camproj` change is covered by round-trip tests.

**Local results** (trial-merged with current origin/main, which was already up to date; debug build)
| suite | result |
|---|---|
| app lib | 95 passed |
| setup_stock_source | 6 passed |
| setup_carry | 5 passed |
| setups | 11 passed |
| setup_relative | 8 passed |
| setup_align | 9 passed |
| project_roundtrip | 69 passed |
| commands_undo | 32 passed |
| setup_sheet | 7 passed |
| stock_sim_document | 9 passed |
| golden_cl | 23 passed |
| posting | 17 passed |
| post_not_judged | 4 passed |
| ui lib (CWD crates/ui) | 308 passed, 2 ignored |
| clippy -D warnings, app + ui, all targets | clean |

**Requested before merge**: none.

**Interaction with open PR #405 (#318), to fix in whichever merges second**
- The two branches merge with no textual conflict (`git merge-tree` is clean). They do not compile together:
```
error[E0004]: non-exhaustive patterns: `Ok(carry::Entry::NewBlock)` not covered
   --> crates\app\src\rest\across.rs:108:15
```
- `rest::across::chain_of` matches only `Entry::Clip` and `Entry::Carry`. #408 adds `Entry::NewBlock`, which is "Own + differently held". The fix is to treat `NewBlock` like `Clip` there: break the chain, so the rest starts from the setup's own fresh block. A wildcard that extends the chain would be the gouge-class mistake, because rest would then assume setup-1 cuts are gone from a new blank. Because it is a hard compile error, the combined branch cannot go wrong silently.
- Semantic point for the same fix: #405's `across.rs` docs say a clip-entered setup keeps a fresh block "until #320". With #408 the user's explicit `Own` is now what decides it, so those comments should be updated. The pinning test should be a flipped setup picked `Own`: rest must not read setup-1 cuts. #405 also reads `FromPrevious` through the same `carry::entry` call, so an explicit pick of "What Setup1 leaves behind" on a same-hold, unlinked setup will carry in both sim and rest. That is the intended sync.
- #405 stamps: the chain digest does not include the stock source, but #408's op stamp does, so a pick still stales both.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `crates/ui/src/state.rs` is 3859 lines. It was already over the 400-line target, and this PR adds about 20 lines.
- `setup_sheet/sections.rs`: the `format!` strings in `render_source` contain literal line breaks instead of `\n`. The output is the same, but it reads oddly in source.
- Changing setup N's pick does not stale later setups' ops that carry from N. That is the same as #401's existing carry staleness, so it is out of scope here.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (delta review of d0e5d07 over the clean 1bb313d review).

**What looks good**
- `rest/across.rs:110` now breaks on `Entry::Clip | Entry::NewBlock` with no wildcard, so a differently-held "Its own stock" pick never extends the chain into setup 1's cuts (no gouge-class read of material the new blank never had). `carry::Entry` has only two consumers (`across.rs`, `stock_sim_carry.rs`); the sim treats `NewBlock` as a fresh `stock_grid` and folds the left-behind gouges into the verdict (`fold_left`), so sim and rest agree on every pick x hold combination. Suppressed-ahead, `carry_refusal` and generation all go through `chain_of`, so they agree too.
- The changed test `a_refused_carry_and_the_first_setup_cannot_be_picked` only gained assertions (generation and sim both refuse the unpicked skew by name before the pick); nothing was dropped. Two new rest tests pin both directions (turned + Own does not read Setup1, with the suppressed-Face1 check; same-held + FromPrevious carries and matches the one-setup rest).
- No unwrap/expect/panic in the touched non-test code. Branch is up to date with current main (trial merge: already up to date).

**Local results** (own worktree and target dir)
| suite | result |
|---|---|
| app lib | 95 pass |
| rest_across_setups | 7 pass |
